{{Quote|Proceed to Cioran on the following course. Do not deviate.|An [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] aboard the [[Ravenous (Imperial-class Star Destroyer)|''Ravenous'']], to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="HAT" />}}
'''Cioran''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Saavin system]],<ref name="HAT" /> a part of the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Ravenous (Imperial-class Star Destroyer)|''Ravenous'']] monitored the traffic around Cioran.<ref name="HAT" />
